description.value: Haida Style Expeditions is a Haida-owned and operated cultural adventure tour company on Haida Gwaii, run by identical twin brothers born into the Tsaahl Eagle Clan with over 35 combined years in tourism. Day tours depart from Daajing Giids Wharf by enclosed-cabin aluminum vessels into Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve, visiting ancient Haida village sites such as Skedans, T'aanuu, Windy Bay, and Hotspring Island with Haida storyteller-guides. Touring cyclists exploring Haida Gwaii will find this a rare opportunity for an authentic Indigenous-led wilderness and cultural experience in one of BC's most remote and spectacular archipelagos.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is fully accessible and provides rich content. Haida Style Expeditions is a real, operating boat-based cultural tour company; the site lists active tours, a booking system, contact details, and a physical office address at the Haida Heritage Centre. The FAQ explicitly confirms restroom availability at the departure wharf and on-board toilets on both vessels. No mention of bike parking, water refill, showers, Wi-Fi, charging, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, no tags, and no address or phone — all contact details sourced exclusively from website. OSM coordinates (53.248, -131.997) place the pin near Skidegate/Daajing Giids, consistent with the stated address and wharf departure point.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating business with live booking, multiple tour offerings, and a physical office at the Haida Heritage Centre. A notable attraction for any cyclist exploring Haida Gwaii.
enrichment_extras.notes: Office is at Haida Heritage Centre at Kay Llnagaay, Skidegate. Tours depart from Daajing Giids Wharf (parking available at wharf). BBQ-style lunch is included in multi-site day tours but is served on-water/at village sites, not from a fixed on-site café.

wow_evidence: Haida-owned boat tours into Gwaii Haanas village sites (Skedans, T'aanuu, Windy Bay) — day-shaping-plus guided cultural experience (operator band caps at 3).
blurb: Haida-owned boat tours to ancient Gwaii Haanas village sites from Daajing Giids.
